tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind every component. Warm grey in light, warm near-black in dark.

tokens.name: on-canvas
tokens.usage: Text placed directly on canvas.

tokens.name: on-canvas-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on canvas (4.9:1 light, 6.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: solid
tokens.usage: The Mochi shape: buttons, island and player, switch track, segmented control, chart card, toast.

tokens.name: on-solid
tokens.usage: Text and icons on solid.

tokens.name: on-solid-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on solid: artist, times, unselected tabs, chart labels (7.4:1 light, 6.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: solid-subtle
tokens.usage: Wells and tracks inside solid: progress track, segmented well, chart grid. Decorative, never text.

tokens.name: solid-border
tokens.usage: Hairline around solid. Invisible in light; separates solid from canvas in dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Quiet surfaces: command palette, slider track, keycap.

tokens.name: on-surface
tokens.usage: Text and icons on surface.

tokens.name: on-surface-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface: placeholders, shortcut hints (4.8:1 light, 6.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: surface-border
tokens.usage: Dividers and the hairline around surface.

tokens.name: surface-border-strong
tokens.usage: Outlined chips on surface, such as the esc key.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Slider fill on surface: black in light, off-white in dark.

tokens.name: on-fill
tokens.usage: Icons that sit over the slider fill.

tokens.name: thumb
tokens.usage: Switch knob, segmented indicator, chart tooltip.

tokens.name: on-thumb
tokens.usage: Text on thumb: the selected tab label, tooltip value.

tokens.name: on-thumb-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on thumb: tooltip date.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent, pastel matcha: accent button, chart line, active command. Always carries on-accent text or sits on solid. Use sparingly.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent (10.6:1).

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Deeper matcha for green that stands alone on canvas or surface: switch on, success marks (3.7:1 on canvas in light).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Soft red for errors: field ring, error icon, destructive highlight (3.2:1 on canvas in light).

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on danger (4.9:1 light, 7.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: danger-strong
tokens.usage: Error text on canvas or surface: messages, invalid labels, destructive menu items (4.7:1 on canvas in light).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline on every interactive element.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind the command palette.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inset of knobs and indicators inside their track.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between rows of a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Side padding of rows and inputs.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Padding of cards and the player.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of large buttons.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space between separate components.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Keyboard hints and small chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Command rows, the active-command highlight, tooltip.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Artwork and inner tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Command palette and keycap.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards: chart card, expanded player.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills and circles: buttons, switch, tabs, slider, toast, island.

tokens.name: shadow-surface
tokens.usage: Lift of solid and surface off the canvas.

tokens.name: shadow-thumb
tokens.usage: Switch knob and segmented indicator.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Tooltip and floating overlays.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Command palette above the scrim.
